title: Missed Parcel in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Find the carrier first.** DHL, Hermes, DPD, GLS, UPS and Amazon each send a missed parcel somewhere else and each runs its own clock.
**DHL branch or partner shop: 7 working days.** Saturdays count, Sundays and holidays do not.
**DHL Packstation: usually 7 calendar days,** weekends and holidays included.
**Hermes: 7 working days** from the day the parcel reaches the shop, with no extension. Older guides still say 10.
**DPD: 7 calendar days in a Pickup shop, only 3 in a DPD locker.** GLS: 8 working days from the day after it arrives.
**Bring ID.** Hermes takes an ID card, a passport or a German residence permit, not a driving licence or a health card.
**After the last day the parcel goes back to the sender,** and with DHL that return cannot be stopped once it starts.
